source_title: IDOT Oversize and Overweight Permits — Policy Manual (92 Ill. Adm. Code 554) + Fee Tables 1 & 2
verify_reasons: Illinois publishes no bright-line dimensional superload definition; width/height/length are null (superload is operational — bridge/pavement structural analysis under 554.1420/554.1640, or auto-superload when axle spacing fails 554.1415). Practical-maximum gross of 120,000 lbs (6+ axle) is encoded as the weight trigger.
Overweight-on-axle-only fees (Table 3) are served by IDOT as a scanned image and were not machine-readable — use the ITAP fee estimator for exact overweight-on-axle cost.

Escort counts escalate on dimension COMBINATIONS (554.1235: two civilian escorts when any pair of width>14'6"/height>14'6"/length>110' is exceeded); the per-dimension matrix here encodes single-dimension triggers and notes the combinations.

superload_thresholds.note: Illinois has no defined 'superload' bright-line. Practical maximum gross weight is 120,000 lbs (6+ axle); loads above this, or towed loads failing the axle-spacing rule (554.1415: steer-to-tandem >=8'1", first trailer axle >=18'6", spacing sum >=43'6"), are processed as superloads requiring bridge/pavement structural analysis ($40/hr + computer cost, 554.1420/554.1640). Dimensions over 15' high, 145' long, or 14'6" wide also push a move into structural review beyond the Table 2 fee ceiling.

width.note: 1 civilian escort over 14'6" wide; 2 escorts if width AND (height>14'6" or length>110') also exceeded (554.1235)
Illinois State Police escort over 18' wide ($80/vehicle/ISP district + hourly, 554.1645)

height.note: 1 civilian escort over 14'6" high; lead escort carries a height pole (554.1240(l))
3 civilian escorts + Illinois State Police over 18' high

length.note: Illinois State Police escort over 200' long

single_trip.fee_formula: Over-dimension single-trip (Table 1, by size category x distance): cat a (<=10'W/14'6"H/70'L) $12-$21; cat b (<=12'W/85'L) $15-$30; cat c (<=14'W/15'H/100'L) $25-$40; cat d (<=18'W/16'H/120'L) $30-$60; cat e (>18'W or >16'H or >120'L) $50-$125. Overweight single-trip (Table 2, by axle/gross category x distance in 45-mi bands): e.g. 6+ axle <=88,000 lbs $10-$35; 6+ axle <=120,000 lbs $30-$280; width 12'7"-14'6" adds +$15; any dimension beyond 15'H/145'L/14'6"W adds the applicable Table 1 fee. Overweight-on-axle-only uses Table 3 (IDOT scanned image — not captured; quote via ITAP estimator).
single_trip.note: 5 working days single-trip (round-trip 10 working days). $5 per revision/extension; superload-weight and LCO supplements +$50 non-refundable.

annual.note: No general annual single-trip permit (annual permit only for movement to train-derailment sites, 625 ILCS 5/15-308.1). Repetitive moves use LCO (Limited Continuous Operation) 3-month/12-month permits: e.g. legal-wt oversize <=10'W $100/3mo-$400/12mo; <=12'W $150/$600; oversize truss <=14'W $250/$1,000; overweight-oversize (practical max) <=12'W $250/3mo-$1,000/12mo.

movement_restrictions: Overweight within legal dimensions: 24/7. OS/OW <=12'W, <=13'6"H, <=200'L: 24/7 (with one additional civilian escort during darkness)
<=14'6" wide and <=15' high: one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset, 7 days

<=16' wide and <=17' high: sunrise-sunset Mon-Fri plus Saturday until noon; EXCEPT Chicago metro counties (Cook, DuPage, Lake, Kane, Madison, McHenry, Monroe, St. Clair, Will) limited to 9:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. Mon-Fri only
Over 16' wide, over 17' high, or over 200' long: 9:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. Mon-Fri, no weekends
Holiday ban from noon the day before to one-half hour before sunrise the day after (New Year's, Memorial, Independence, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas)

Cook County expressways: loads over practical-max weight, over 12' wide or over 13'6" high prohibited (listed I-55/I-57/I-290/I-294/I-94/I-80 exceptions); Chicago Central Business District requires a separate City permit
No movement on snow/ice or impaired visibility; house trailers over 12' wide banned when wind gusts exceed 25 mph
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", semitrailer 53' (Class I/II), gross 80,000 lbs (single axle 20,000 / tandem 34,000, federal bridge formula).
Escort matrix (554.1235) and fee Tables 1 & 2 sourced from official IDOT documents. Note: the correct permit portal is ITAP (Illinois Transportation Automated Permits), not the iPASS tollway site.
State-level rules only — county/city permits (Cook County, City of Chicago), bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope.
